blocks.text: Statistical model banane ke kai qadam hain. Aayein unhein ek ek kar ke dekhein:
Step 1: Masla tay karein (Define the Problem)
Pehle masla samajhna zaroori hai. Misal: agar grocery ke kharche ki pesh-goi karni hai to jaanna hoga ke kaunse awamil kharcha barhate hain (maslan khandan ka size, jagah ya aamdani).
Phir masle se mutalliqa data jama karte hain. Hamari misal mein pichhle kharche ki aadatein, khandan ke afraad ki tadaad aur grocery ke kharche par asar dalne wale doosre awamil ka data jama karenge.

Masle aur data ko dekh kar algorithm chunte hain. Algorithms woh tareeqe hain jin se model banta hai. Mashhoor algorithms linear regression aur logistic regression hain, jo isi hisse mein aage aayenge.
Step 4: Model train karein (Train the Model)
Phir model ko data se train kiya jata hai, yani model data se seekhta hai ta ke pesh-goi kar sake.
Aakhir mein naye data se model ko aazmaya jata hai ke woh kitna achha kaam karta hai. Yeh qadam bohat aham hai ta ke yaqeen ho ke model achhi pesh-goi karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Linear regression jaisa bunyadi statistical model banane ke qadam bataiye: data collection, training aur evaluation samait. (Long question 2)
blocks.explanation: Sawal aur variables tay karein (phal ke stall mein customers X aur kamai Y). Qabil-e-aitbaar data jama karein, saaf karein aur graph par dekhein ke taluq seedhi line jaisa lagta hai. Linear regression chunein aur train karein: data par baithne wala slope aur intercept nikalein (yahan Earnings = 100 + 40 × Customers). Naye data par pesh-goi ko asal se mila kar jaanchein (28 customers: andaza 1,220, asal 1,250, error −30) aur error ya accuracy metrics istemal karein. Phir nateeja samjhein aur naya data aane par model update karein.

items: Paanch qadam: masla tay karna, data jama karna, algorithm chunna, train karna, naye data par jaanchna.
